items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: So Jack Washington got to raise his hand and he's trying to find his note...

ctx.x: Yeah. All that I wanted to do was just change keys. If he didn't change keys, I would have said something. But put the D-flat so it would sound weird(?), and get that beautiful tone. And I put the alto just right. And the other cats all fall in underneath there, with the harmony and everything. So we played the first night, and everybody, even the boss man, said, "You all play that tune that the band ...(?). . . jumpin' them keys." He said, "You all play that again." We had to play it three or four times a night.…
